summary: Luxury speed email client — high willingness to pay, but AI native inbox assistants are matching its 100ms speed.
moat: Superhuman's moat is prestige branding and keyboard muscle memory: elite founders, VCs, and executives pay $30/month for its sub-100ms offline sync architecture, keyboard command palette, and social status. Its onboarding concierge model created intense early customer loyalty. The threat is that every major email client and indie vibe-coder now adds AI drafting, auto-triaging, and split inboxes natively at zero extra cost.

challengers.name: Shortwave, Spark AI, and AI email copilots
challengers.evidence: Shortwave and modern email AI tools offer autonomous email drafting and inbox summarization powered by LLMs, directly eroding Superhuman's speed advantage.
